title: PHILGEPS + UNGM OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING

executive_summary.source_access_notes: PhilGEPS official public category pages were checked live on September 2, 2026 and the first visible page for each scoped category was reviewed, followed by direct official-notice rechecks for tracked and newly surfaced candidates. UNGM public search and notice pages were scanned live through the repo runtime; no login-gated sources were used.

best_opportunities.project: Database portal to support continuous operation, maintenance and upgrade of the GAD database portal
best_opportunities.procurement_method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34) / RFQ
best_opportunities.why_fit: This is the clearest new live fit from today’s PhilGEPS scan because the official abstract explicitly covers system development and enhancement, hosting, security, database management, backup, maintenance, technical support, training, and user support for an existing government portal.
important_requirements: Official PhilGEPS public notice showed status Active when checked on September 2, 2026

Official abstract lists GAD Data Base Portal Phase II with system development and enhancement, workflow diagram, infrastructure and hosting, security and data protection, database management and backup, maintenance and technical support, compliance updates, training, and emergency support
Procurement mode shown publicly is Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34)
Public notice shows Solicitation Number CGT-Goods-2026-410 and ABC PHP 850,000.00
Official public contact shown in the notice: Aprilene Agojo Natanauan, Admin Officer II, aprilenen@yahoo.com, tel. +63-43-728 ext. 9837
Public abstract does not clearly state the required PhilGEPS membership level, submission packaging, or prior-project threshold
risks_or_blockers: The public notice shows Delivery Period 0 Day/s while the description lists a substantial system-enhancement scope, so the official fields are internally inconsistent
No public line-item breakdown or openly accessible RFQ attachment was visible from the abstract page, so user counts, modules, acceptance criteria, and migration scope still need confirmation
Because it is still classified as Goods, the buyer may expect a more formal supply-style submission package even though the real work looks service-led
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Request the RFQ or TOR immediately and confirm whether the 0 Day/s delivery field is a posting error, what Phase II already includes, the hosting environment, user load, security/privacy obligations, and whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable.

best_opportunities.project: Procurement of One (1) Lot Webhosting and maintenance of Dagupan City Website
best_opportunities.why_fit: This is still a direct AIStaff-style website operations opportunity under a simple small-value route, and it remains in-scope today because the official notice was still Active during the September 2, 2026 recheck and closes the same day.
important_requirements: Official PhilGEPS public notice still showed status Active when rechecked on September 2, 2026
Public notice shows Solicitation Number 286-5N-26, category Services, classification Goods, ABC PHP 120,000.00, and delivery period 30 Day/s
Public abstract states webhosting and maintenance of dagupan.gov.ph with renewal and one warranty language
Official public contact shown in the notice: Monette T. De Venecia, BAC Secretariat Member, asi_aaron@yahoo.com, tel. +63-75-5154780
The public abstract still does not expose the detailed eligibility checklist, PhilGEPS membership level, or incumbent-transition conditions
risks_or_blockers: The word renewal still suggests incumbent advantage or an existing hosting arrangement that may not be easy to replace quickly
The public abstract remains too thin to confirm infrastructure scope, CMS stack, backups, security duties, content maintenance expectations, or support hours
The deadline is noon on September 2, 2026, so it is only actionable immediately if the RFQ package can be obtained at once
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Request the RFQ package immediately and verify whether this is a straightforward renewal, whether a new supplier can assume the hosting stack cleanly, and who controls the domain, hosting account, backups, and CMS credentials.

urgent_deadlines.project: Procurement of One (1) Lot Webhosting and maintenance of Dagupan City Website
urgent_deadlines.note: Carry-forward direct-fit item. The official notice was still Active on September 2, 2026, but the public abstract is sparse and the same-day deadline leaves almost no preparation margin.

not_recommended.project: Supply and Installation of Centralized Municipal Government System of LGU Alaminos, Laguna
not_recommended.reason: The title is relevant, but the public abstract exposes only attached documents for scope, the route is full public bidding, the value is PHP 3.85M, and the requirement appears broad enough to favor a more established municipal-systems integrator with stronger government delivery history.

not_recommended.project: SUBSCRIPTION TO WEBSITE APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT TOOLS FOR THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT OF CAVITE’S WEBSITE UPGRADE
not_recommended.reason: This is mainly a branded tool and plugin subscription purchase. Even though the public notice allows Red PhilGEPS membership below PHP 1M, it still reads as a procurement of named software/services and warranty-backed supply rather than a custom AIStaff implementation or managed-service engagement.

not_recommended.project: SUPPLY, DELIVERY, INSTALLATION, COMMISSIONING AND TESTING OF MANAGED VOICE SOLUTION FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A 911 EMERGENCY CONTACT CENTER (EMERGENCY HOTLINE) IN NARRA, PALAWAN
not_recommended.reason: The voice/contact-center theme is attractive, but the official abstract requires a similar contract worth at least 50% of the ABC, paid bidding documents, bid security, and a larger telecom-style implementation that is too infrastructure-heavy for AIStaff’s current profile.

This is the closest direct chatbot fit in today’s UNGM scan, but it is Spanish-language, Mexico-specific, and aimed at mobility-related financial-health inquiries in Mexico. It does not meet today’s priority for English-language opportunities with realistic first-entry delivery conditions for AIStaff.

not_recommended.project: Provision of CRM Solution support and maintenance services for Salesforce application
not_recommended.reason: The CRM theme is relevant, but the public UNGM notice explicitly calls for recognized Salesforce expertise including Nonprofit Cloud consultant certification, which is a material qualification blocker for AIStaff today.

The work is relevant on paper, but it is a multi-municipality Syria MIS build with local delivery, localization, and institutional-complexity risk that is not a realistic first UN pursuit for AIStaff.

This requires a prime integrator for end-to-end PMIS provisioning, Oracle Fusion and Microsoft 365 integration, migration, training, change management, and SLA-backed support. That is too enterprise-heavy for AIStaff’s current positioning.

todays_recommendation.best_opportunity: Database portal to support continuous operation, maintenance and upgrade of the GAD database portal (PhilGEPS Ref 13220191) is the best opportunity to pursue on September 2, 2026 because it is new today, service-compatible with AIStaff’s systems and support capabilities, and more realistic for a small supplier than the broader public-bidding municipal-system notice.

Short implementation note covering hosting ownership, security controls, backup and restore, change management, training, and support SLAs
clarifications_to_request: For Tanauan: whether the posted Delivery Period 0 Day/s is an encoding error or whether another official schedule controls
For Tanauan: the actual Phase II module list, user count, hosting environment, backup responsibilities, security/privacy requirements, and acceptance criteria
For Tanauan: whether Red PhilGEPS registration is acceptable for this small-value procurement
For Dagupan: whether the requirement is a simple renewal with an incumbent or a competitive opening for a new hosting and maintenance supplier
For Dagupan: who controls the domain, hosting account, CMS stack, backups, and current support credentials

notes: PhilGEPS was checked only through official public pages. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, or restricted bid-document access was attempted.
Today's PhilGEPS scan reviewed the first visible public page for the six scoped categories, totaling 102 visible listings, then directly rechecked tracked and newly surfaced official notice pages.
UNGM was checked through the official public search and notice pages using the repo runtime. No login-gated source was used.

No new UNGM notice survived today's realism filter strongly enough for BEST OPPORTUNITIES. The previously reported UNDRR creative-services EOI (UNGM Notice 312141) was rechecked but omitted because it is unchanged from prior runs and does not close within the next three days.
The previously reported CCP website hosting RFQ (PhilGEPS Ref 13217867) was not carried forward because its September 1, 2026 deadline is already in the past relative to this September 2, 2026 run.
No bids were submitted, no registrations were created, and no procurement emails were sent. This run is research and reporting only.
